find: if (activePanelContainer() !== panel) return; // a pane is over the menu: not its focus to move
why: The Main Menu's arrival follow (issue #919) moves focus only while the menu is the surface on top. Without the check, a repaint of the run while a pane is open and focus has fallen to <body> puts focus on a menu button hidden under the pane: `focusableControls` judges the controls, never the container that holds them.
